title: Prove exact finite Gaussian rounding thresholds with compact Hall witnesses and independently checked orbit-flow certificates
body:
## Exact result
Proves finite optimal outward slack sqrt(21)-sqrt(19) on radius5, sqrt(31)-sqrt(28) on radii6/7, and sqrt(78)-sqrt(73) on radii9/11 for injective error-one H4/2 rounding. Radius10 follows by inclusion. The latter is a necessary global lower bound; global attainment remains open. Exact signed permutations transfer the result to the #6509 Gaussian pair.

## Verification and scope
Includes a compact radius-five Hall proof, exact positive orbit-flow certificates, and the proof that biregularity lifts them to finite injections. An independent full-point checker verifies all four extension graphs; separate full-vertex radius-nine matching agrees. Normal/optimized replays and corruption/tie controls pass. All five multiplication assumptions remain; no new kappa.

[Full description, exact pins, proof, reproduction and limitations](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3c7c3e8000f592fd9adecb44008ff6d5ae5d453d/research/sharp-finite-gaussian-outward-slack/PR-DESCRIPTION.md).
